name: wordle_helper
description: Wordle helper: score a guess against an answer with the game's rule for repeated letters, filter a word list by the green/yellow/grey feedback of earlier guesses, and rank the next guesses by expected information (entropy of the feedback pattern) or letter frequency. Uses the word list given or a bundled list of five-letter words from SCOWL (permissive ESDB licence).

feedback.description: g/y/. per letter (also 2/1/0 or the coloured squares)

words.description: Allowed words, all the same length (default: bundled five-letter list)

hard_mode.description: Suggest only words that could still be the answer

score.description: Only compute the feedback of one guess

catalog.source: original; feedback rules of the game Wordle (Josh Wardle, 2021; The New York Times); entropy ranking after Shannon (1948); word list from SCOWL/ESDB by Kevin Atkinson (ESDB licence), via tools/catalog/data/wordle_helper.py
